lede: BGK bonds for the COVID-19 Fund (FPC) carry an explicit State Treasury guarantee, i.e. the same credit as POLGBs. Prices are thin Catalyst retail closes (27 Mar 2026; FPC0231 traded a single bond), so levels are indicative. Spread vs POLGB = yield minus the fitted POLGB curve for the same cash flows; ASW = yield minus PLN IRS.

bonds.note: no trade on 27 Mar 2026; last Catalyst close 26 Mar 2026 (stale: treat as indicative)

takeaways_html: FPC fixed lines trade ~-2-23bp over the POLGB curve (average 13bp); widest ASW FPC0235 at 116bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: FPC0229 (+22bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).

Supply: BGK cancelled the 12 Mar FPC auction and says ~60% of its 2026 FPC financing is already raised (11 Mar); on 26 Mar it sold only PLN 0.87bn (demand 1.06bn) plus 0.20bn - quasi demand is thin in the sell-off.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
sources: Catalyst closes of 27 Mar 2026 via biznesradar historical pages; BGK FPC 2026 plan (reported 24 Sep 2025); FPC 2025 plan amendment (15 Oct 2025); PAP on the cancelled 9 Dec 2025 auction; Pekao market-maker agreement (13 Nov 2025). Yields recomputed with annual ACT/ACT coupons on each bond's anniversary dates.
